Title: LibreNMS: Stored XSS via graph_descr admin config settings echoed without escaping to all authenticated users
Description: The `graph_descr.<graphtype>` family of settings is echoed verbatim without `htmlspecialchars()` in `includes/html/pages/graphs.inc.php:194`. Any admin can store a malicious HTML payload that executes in every authenticated user's browser viewing that graph type.
